files.title: files

workspace.read.effect: Return bounded decoded text and full-byte SHA-256; nextOffset paginates text
workspace.read.pre: Nonblank existing text file resolves under root; no NUL in first 8192 bytes; offset >=0

workspace.search.effect: Search actual workspace text; complete=false means deadline stopped traversal, not absence
workspace.search.pre: Query string; includeGlob narrows workspace; bounded maxResults

workspace.write.effect: Atomically create or CAS-replace text, create parents and verify persisted bytes; refuses concurrent overwrite
workspace.write.pre: Allowed write scope; root-confined path with no symlink/junction; UTF-8 <=1 MiB no NUL; existing file requires matching expectedSha256; absent file must omit it

artifact.publish.effect: Publish the bytes already written in the selected workspace and record their hash and session provenance
artifact.publish.pre: An existing report beneath the selected workspace and a stable request id

artifact.get.effect: Read the publication and check its exact current bytes

artifact.list.effect: List published workspace outputs newest first with an optional session or run filter
artifact.list.pre: Selected workspace and bounded page size

artifact.open.effect: Refuse changed or missing bytes before requesting the existing artifact pane
artifact.open.pre: Known publication whose saved bytes are unchanged

replace.question: Does the replacement preserve the intended source and concurrent changes?

search-coverage.constraints: Only complete=true establishes coverage for searched glob; maxResults truncation and complete=false require narrower glob/query or direct known path. Do not paste entire files into context.
search-coverage.question: Is this bounded search enough to identify the intended file?

Reread and merge current source; do not reuse stale hash

Continue nextOffset or narrow includeGlob; a bounded result cannot prove global absence. Local-only search runs in-process before any child launch; regex timeout returns complete=false. Literal queries work without optional dependencies; complex regex requires the cl dependency.

pitfalls.failure: Write traverses symlink/junction or escapes root
pitfalls.recovery: Choose a plain root-confined path; no bypass
Use file-specific tools; workspace.write is bounded UTF-8 text

pitfalls.failure: Mutation result differs between native HTTP and durable MCP gateway
pitfalls.recovery: Gateway wraps operation data under toolResult; this procedure verifies fresh workspace.read bytes instead of assuming a mutation return shape.

frontier: Atomic compare-and-swap is not general merge resolution
Binary writes and outside-root files are not mapped by workspace tools

Larger writes remain supported by workspace.write, but simple host goals and create-and-confirm are bounded to 20000 characters. Author an explicit observer G for larger writes; existing-file CAS and full-byte SHA-256 still apply.
